beliefs: On x>=0, f(x) = 106.06 + 111.43*x is accurate to ~0.1% across 0.1 to 127 [E1, E2, E3]
On x<=-2, f(x) = 26.07*|x| - 25.4 is accurate to ~0.1% across |x| from 2 to 128 [E5, E6, E3, E4]
The negative branch has a smooth trough bottoming near |x|=1.05 with f(-1.05)=6.37, rising to f(-2)=26.7 [E7, E9]
For |x| between 0 and 1, f falls from ~106 at x=0 to ~6.85 at |x|=1, but not linearly: slope steepens with |x| (f(-0.5)=50.34, f(-0.62)=36.97, f(-0.9)=10.63) [E8, E9]
f(0)≈106 is a spike; both branches approach ~106 at x=0 [E1, E3]
notes: Replaced the linear near-zero negative branch with a quadratic fit through E8/E9 points (f(-0.5)=50.34, f(-0.62)=36.97, f(-0.9)=10.63, f(-1)=6.85), and refit the trough using E9's dense sweep with bottom near |x|=1.05.
